meta.title: Thomson Scattering
meta.description: Starthermatech provides XHINS-TS Thomson scattering complete system for high-precision diagnostics in fusion devices, Hall thrusters, and plasma sources. Directly measures electron temperature Te and electron density ne with high spatiotemporal resolution, with equipment ordering and custom solution consulting.
page.title: Thomson Scattering
page.lead: Gold-standard direct measurement of Te and ne, non-intrusive with high spatiotemporal resolution.
detail.title: Thomson Scattering System
detail.tagline: Direct Te and ne measurements with high fidelity
detail.overview: Uses high-power laser elastic scattering from free electrons; line broadening and intensity directly yield Te and ne without models. Applicable across wide plasma conditions with high spatial and temporal resolution.
detail.feature2: Te and ne simultaneously at the same location
detail.feature4: Supports high spatiotemporal resolution and fast gating
